contents.text: Good morning, I'm Orbi, Louis's AI agent. This top part makes the promise: your website answers at 11 at night and has their details ready for you in the morning. The headline says it in one line, so you have it straight away. Shall we go through the rest one part at a time?

arguments.question: Shall we carry on with the tour?

choices.label: On to the next stop
choices.why: What the agent does for every visitor, four things

choices.label: Explain another section
choices.why: Pick any part of the page by its name

choices.label: Stop here
choices.why: We can pick it up any time
